_comment: CataWard Sorsogon Hazard Map — Data Source Catalog. Each layer entry records the authoritative source, access status, and instructions for adding verified data. Do NOT add fabricated data; mark unavailable layers as such.

basemap.provider: OpenStreetMap contributors via CARTO (Positron light basemap)
basemap.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO
basemap.license: ODbL (OpenStreetMap data); see https://carto.com/legal/ for CARTO tile terms

province_boundary.name: Sorsogon Province Administrative Boundary
province_boundary.license: Free for non-commercial use; see https://gadm.org/license.html
province_boundary.notes: Province polygon extracted from GADM PHL level-2 GeoJSON. Used only to set map extent and draw a reference boundary. Does not imply any hazard characterisation.

typhoon.name: Typhoon Hazard
typhoon.source_organization: PAGASA — Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration
typhoon.dataset_title: Sorsogon Typhoon Track / Storm Surge Hazard Map (provincial/municipal level)
typhoon.how_to_obtain: Request or download typhoon track data and storm surge hazard maps from PAGASA GIS portal or their Open Data page. PAGASA provides historical tropical cyclone track data in CSV/KML; convert to GeoJSON before loading.
typhoon.how_to_add: Place the GeoJSON file at assets/data/typhoon_hazard.geojson and set status to 'available'. Update the 'accessed' field and attribution in this file.
typhoon.notes: PAGASA provides wind signal maps and track forecasts operationally but static provincial-level storm surge hazard polygons for Sorsogon were not publicly downloadable as of 2026-09-27. The NDRRMC / OCD Sorsogon office may hold digitised versions.

flood.name: Flood Hazard
flood.source_organization: MGB — Mines and Geosciences Bureau, DENR
flood.dataset_title: MGB Multi-Hazard Map — Flood Susceptibility, Sorsogon Province
flood.how_to_obtain: MGB publishes provincial multi-hazard maps on their website and coordinates with LGUs. Request the Sorsogon flood susceptibility GeoJSON or shapefile from MGB Regional Office V (Bicol).
flood.how_to_add: Place the GeoJSON at assets/data/flood_hazard.geojson and set status to 'available'. Add the MGB attribution string. Update 'accessed'.
flood.notes: MGB shapefile datasets for Sorsogon flood susceptibility were not freely downloadable in GeoJSON/shapefile format from a public web endpoint as of 2026-09-27. LGU DRRM offices sometimes host copies. NOAH (UP Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards) also produced flood maps — check https://noah.up.edu.ph/.

earthquake.name: Earthquake Hazard
earthquake.source_organization: PHIVOLCS — Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology
earthquake.dataset_title: Active Fault Lines and Earthquake-Induced Hazard Maps, Sorsogon
earthquake.how_to_obtain: PHIVOLCS publishes active fault line data and earthquake-induced hazard maps. Download the Philippine Active Fault database (available as KML/shapefile from PHIVOLCS GIS) and filter to Sorsogon. Convert to GeoJSON.
earthquake.how_to_add: Place fault GeoJSON at assets/data/earthquake_faults.geojson and set status to 'available'. Add PHIVOLCS attribution. Update 'accessed'.
earthquake.notes: PHIVOLCS active fault map KML files are available on their website for download but require GIS conversion. As of 2026-09-27 a direct GeoJSON download endpoint for provincial scope was not confirmed. The East Sorsogon Fault and nearby Philippine Fault System segments are documented in PHIVOLCS literature.

landslide.name: Landslide Hazard
landslide.source_organization: MGB — Mines and Geosciences Bureau, DENR
landslide.dataset_title: MGB Multi-Hazard Map — Landslide Susceptibility, Sorsogon Province
landslide.how_to_obtain: Same as flood: request from MGB Regional Office V or check DOST GeoPortal / NAMRIA.
landslide.how_to_add: Place the GeoJSON at assets/data/landslide_hazard.geojson and set status to 'available'. Add MGB attribution. Update 'accessed'.
landslide.notes: MGB landslide susceptibility data for Sorsogon is referenced in provincial DRRM plans but was not freely available as a public GeoJSON endpoint as of 2026-09-27.

tsunami.name: Tsunami Hazard
tsunami.source_organization: PHIVOLCS — Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology
tsunami.dataset_title: Tsunami Inundation Hazard Maps, Sorsogon Coast
tsunami.how_to_obtain: PHIVOLCS produces Tsunami Hazard Assessment and inundation maps for coastal municipalities. Contact PHIVOLCS or OCD Region V for the Sorsogon-specific inundation polygon shapefiles.
tsunami.how_to_add: Place the GeoJSON at assets/data/tsunami_inundation.geojson and set status to 'available'. Add PHIVOLCS attribution. Update 'accessed'.
tsunami.notes: Sorsogon is a high-priority province for PHIVOLCS tsunami assessment given its coastline exposure. As of 2026-09-27 digitised inundation GeoJSON for the province was not found at a public download endpoint; printed/raster maps exist in PHIVOLCS publications.

evacuation_centers.name: Designated Evacuation Centers
evacuation_centers.dataset_title: Official Designated Evacuation Centers, Sorsogon Province
evacuation_centers.how_to_obtain: Request the official list from the Sorsogon Province DRRM Office (PDRRMO) or DSWD Region V. Data must include facility name, barangay, municipality, GPS coordinates, and verification date.
evacuation_centers.how_to_add: Create assets/data/evacuation_centers.geojson following the schema in the data README. Set status to 'available'. Include the source contact and date.
evacuation_centers.notes: Do not use crowd-sourced or unverified lists. Evacuation center designations change after every disaster; always check current PDRRMO records.

hospitals.name: Hospitals and Health Facilities
hospitals.dataset_title: Licensed Health Facilities, Region V — Sorsogon
hospitals.how_to_obtain: DOH maintains the Health Facility Registry (HFR) at https://hfr.doh.gov.ph/. Filter by Region V, Province: Sorsogon. Data includes facility name, type, address, contact. Export/scrape with DOH permission or request a data share.
hospitals.how_to_add: Create assets/data/hospitals.geojson with DOH HFR data. Set status to 'available'. Include facility name, address, contact, DOH license number, and access date.
hospitals.notes: DOH HFR data was accessible via the web interface but bulk GeoJSON export was not confirmed as of 2026-09-27. A manual survey or FOIA request may be needed.
